'''The White Door''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] situated in the port town [[Akmalla]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> that operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|171|Jokot}}</ref> the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Kelna Toodo]] was tasked by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Beeda]] with eliminating a group of individuals who had meddled with Beeda's affairs, and Toodo planned to trick the individuals into gaining possession of the [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|Barzo cargo freighter]] ''[[Radiant Splendor]]'', on which he had placed a trap for them. To that end, Toodo approached the individuals inside The White Door and invited them to a midnight [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game in the cantina's back room. The game was attended by the Toodo, the meddlers, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jokot]], the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Lar-Odo]] and Toodo's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] accomplice [[Lyt Re]], and during the game, Re posed as the owner of the ''Spelendor'' and deliberately played badly, and she gambled away ownership of the ''Splendor'' to Toodo's targets.<ref name="Cat and Mouse" />
